MB=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in R62.strip().split("\n")]); IXm={c:i for i,c in enumerate(O)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IXm.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def align(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    ea,eb=enc(a),enc(b); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.where((ea[:,None]>=0)&(eb[None,:]>=0),MB[np.clip(ea,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(eb,0,19)[None,:]],-1).astype(float)
    NEG=-1e9; Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=0.0; pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=0.0; pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sr=S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(Mm[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]); k=int(np.argmax(c)); Mm[i,j]=c[k]+sr[j-1]; pM[i,j]=k
            cx=(Mm[i-1,j]+(0 if j==m else go), Ix[i-1,j]+(0 if j==m else ge)); kx=int(np.argmax(cx)); Ix[i,j]=cx[kx]; pX[i,j]=0 if kx==0 else 1
            cy=(Mm[i,j-1]+(0 if i==n else go), Iy[i,j-1]+(0 if i==n else ge)); ky=int(np.argmax(cy)); Iy[i,j]=cy[ky]; pY[i,j]=0 if ky==0 else 2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))); pairs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); st=int(pM[i,j]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: pairs.append((i-1,None)); st=int(pX[i,j]); i-=1
        else: pairs.append((None,j-1)); st=int(pY[i,j]); j-=1
        if i==0 and st==1: st=2
        if j==0 and st==2: st=1
    return pairs[::-1]
ACC={"rat GC-A (NPR1)":"P18910","human GC-B (NPR2)":"P20594","human retGC1 (GUCY2D)":"Q02846",
 "human retGC2 (GUCY2F)":"P51841","human GC-C (GUCY2C)":"P25092","Chlamydomonas Cyg12":"Q5YLC2",
 "C. elegans ODR-1":"B1Q257","C. elegans DAF-11":"Q8I4N4","human sGC alpha-1":"Q02108",
 "human sGC beta-1":"Q02153","human AC5 C1 half":"O95622","human AC5 C2 half":"O95622"}
DOMW={"rat GC-A (NPR1)":(847,1057),"human GC-B (NPR2)":(836,1047),"human retGC1 (GUCY2D)":(855,1085),
 "human retGC2 (GUCY2F)":(859,1089),"human GC-C (GUCY2C)":(799,1029),"Chlamydomonas Cyg12":(452,730),
 "C. elegans ODR-1":(814,1044),"C. elegans DAF-11":(740,970),"human sGC alpha-1":(456,683),
 "human sGC beta-1":(396,619),"human AC5 C1 half":(444,671),"human AC5 C2 half":(1046,1261)}
cache={}; F={}
for k,a in ACC.items():
    if a not in cache: cache[a]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
    F[k]=cache[a]
REF="rat GC-A (NPR1)"; r0,r1=DOMW[REF]; rw=F[REF][r0-1:r1]
CAT=[("Asp-1\nmetal",877,"D","C1"),("Asp-2\nmetal",921,"D","C1"),("Glu\nguanine",917,"E","C2"),
     ("Cys\nguanine",989,"C","C2"),("Asn\nTS",996,"N","C2"),("Arg\nTS",1000,"R","C2")]
rows=list(ACC)
cells=[]; okm=np.zeros((len(rows),6))
for i,k in enumerate(rows):
    s0,s1=DOMW[k]; qw=F[k][s0-1:s1]
    m={r0+ri:(qw[qi],s0+qi) for qi,ri in align(qw,rw) if qi is not None and ri is not None}
    row=[]
    for j,(n,c,e,h) in enumerate(CAT):
        aa,p=m.get(c,("-",None)); row.append(f"{aa}{p}" if p else "-"); okm[i,j]= 1 if aa==e else 0
    cells.append(row)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,7.2))
for i in range(len(rows)):
    for j in range(6):
        col = "#2f7d5c" if okm[i,j] else "#b3402f"
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j,len(rows)-1-i),1,1,facecolor=col,alpha=0.82,edgecolor="white",lw=2))
        ax.text(j+0.5,len(rows)-1-i+0.5,cells[i][j],ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=9.5,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(0,6); ax.set_ylim(0,len(rows))
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(6)+0.5); ax.set_xticklabels([c[0] for c in CAT],fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(rows))+0.5); ax.set_yticklabels(rows[::-1],fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(length=0)
for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
ax.axvline(2,color="k",lw=2.5)
ax.text(1.0,len(rows)+0.42,"donated by the C1-type subunit",ha="center",fontsize=10,style="italic")
ax.text(4.0,len(rows)+0.42,"donated by the C2-type subunit",ha="center",fontsize=10,style="italic")
for y,lab in [(len(rows)-6,""),]:
    pass
ax.axhline(len(rows)-6,color="k",lw=1.2,ls=":")
ax.axhline(len(rows)-8,color="k",lw=1.2,ls=":")
ax.axhline(len(rows)-10,color="k",lw=1.2,ls=":")
ax.set_title("Class III cyclase catalytic residues scored by star alignment on rat GC-A numbering\n"
             "green = canonical residue present, red = substituted",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(cells,index=rows,columns=[c[0].replace("\n"," ") for c in CAT]).to_csv("odr1_catalytic_matrix.csv")
